surfaces.question: Which maintained entrypoints, mirrors, callers and native bridges own intake, execution, capture, deadlines and cleanup?
Which historical source copies and distinct versions remain, and which managed routes can still load them?
Which compiled helper, fixture and candidate images remain, with what identity and supported source/build binding?
Which launchers, generators, wrappers, imports and publication paths can reach the helpers or old images?
What do the exact saved gate records establish, what failed, and which changed sources need new validation?
What relevant startup or scheduling entries are actually observable within the authorized scope?
Can current process/image ownership be observed through a permitted route, and what remains unknown?

discovery_notes: Start from repository source and caller closure, not only keyword matches.
Retained .build product images may be relevant even when dependency checkouts and compiler caches are excluded.
Exclude credential paths before opening content; do not unpack archives by inference.
A source-only assessment may declare a narrower question, but must not relabel it as live-system clearance.
